description: Retrieve root-to-tip classification and optional direct children for an AphiaID or canonical WoRMS LSID. resultOffset indexes lineage followed by fetched children; consume nextResultOffset with unchanged options and upstream offset before advancing page.nextOffset and resetting resultOffset to zero. Missing ranks remain unknown; child offset and filters are inactive without includeChildren. A full fetched 50-row child page has uncertain continuation and can lead to an empty page. The submitted ID keeps its own recorded lineage; a notice names its linked accepted ID, distinguishing an accepted alternative representation from its preferred ID.

extantOnly.description: Extant children only; inactive without includeChildren.

includeChildren.description: Also fetch one page of direct children.

marineOnly.description: Marine or brackish children only; inactive without includeChildren.

offset.description: One-based starting record, advancing by 50; default 1.

resultOffset.description: Zero-based position in lineage followed by fetched children; keep upstream offset unchanged until nextResultOffset is null.

Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.
